name: Closing Data 2
definition: Set of data specified for the fixing of a non deliverable trade.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date at which the trading parties have agreed on a valuation rate for a non deliverable trade.

NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Refers to the identification of a trade assigned by the trading side of a non deliverable forward trade.

CommonReference.name: Common Reference
CommonReference.definition: Reference common to the parties of a trade.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Refers to the identification of a previous event in the life of a non deliverable forward trade.

AmendOrCancelReason.name: Amend Or Cancel Reason
AmendOrCancelReason.definition: Describes the reason for the cancellation or the amendment.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts traded at the valuation of a non-deliverable trade.

ValuationRate.name: Valuation Rate
ValuationRate.definition: Rate obtained at valuation time by following the valuation conditions (agreed upon by the trading parties at the opening of the non-deliverable contract).

ValuationInformation.name: Valuation Information
ValuationInformation.definition: Set of parameters used to calculate the valuation rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.
